_what: Where the Media screen reads its library, search and pictures (media-library-read.ts, media-search.ts, media-pictures.ts, media-playback.ts): the person's own files, as their files owner keeps them. The library is one row per media file of ns_file (a file whose media type's first part is one of `kinds`), named by its newest name from ns_name, newest first, `limit` at a time; a page after the first starts after the last row of the one before. `total` counts every such file. `views` says, for each saved view of the screen, which files it asks for: `stored` true or false, or every file when absent. Read by `tool` with `credential_name` (SQL on the person's own database). `files_tool` is the files owner (tool:your-files) for pictures (thumbnail) and playback (read_file_span, `span_bytes` a window). `search` is the picture search: `embed_tool` turns the words into a picture-space vector, the nearest `pool` frames are read from media_index_vectors, and the best frame of each file is kept, the `results` best files shown.
